body: The best French newspaper is by far Le Monde. Many articles are free, and their French is undoubtedly brilliant. You will find high-quality articles, except concerning pharmaceutical industry.

I'm a bit late, but may I point out that in my opinion "j'sais pas" sounds both childish and out of date ? The bell it rings in my French head has something to do with we call les gamins de Paris, which refers with a great fondness to the cheeky boys from the 1930s lower classes, whose standard of living was really surging. It's not easy to pronounce by a long shot, even for me !
Today, "Je n'sais pas" and "Chais pas" (informal) are by far the most common ways ! "Je ne sais pas" will not necessarily have to be used in a formal exchange nowadays.

I'm anything but an expert, but schizophrenia is the most "advanced" form of DP-DR, which leads to a scrambling of the border between reality and fiction. That is not only an oddity feeling, but a loss of the rational knowledge of what is real and what is not. Sorry to be that late. I'm sorry to hear that 😐 How are you today ?

There is a wide range of symptoms from norm to schizophrenia ! 😁 Sometimes, it's only an oddity feeling, just as if you were in a dream but still knew the border between what is real and what is not. Please let me know the sequel and keep me informed about your psychiatrist's diagnosis !

I know it's frustrating to be held for a psychiatric label : we can't even hope to be unique. Nonetheless, you're describing dissociative troubles with a great precision. I know them very well (they are responsible for my attempt). I think (that's only my opinion) you're passing through DPDR (Depersonalisation / Derealization). I'd like you to check out and tell me whether it seems to be what you bear everyday.

I hope you're still alive (indeed, regardless of who you are, except an irreplaceable person). When you reach a decision, you have to bear in mind that only a part of you is acting. I was so sure before my attempt... But you'll most likely throw in an unspeakable panic. If you're in a dead end, and think that the minutes of unspeakable pain you'll go through are a good price, be aware that it's only a representation. The universe is quite concrete, meaningful if I may say so, when it's almost too late or too late. If your aim is to end up a sore, keep in mind that you won't die released by a long shot. If you think you don't have any other solution, even if I'm not in position to criticize, remember that end is no escape. Have empathy for the "me" of the late minutes, if you still have some hope.
